        "contents": "-- Migration: Initial schema setup\n-- Purpose: Creates complete database schema with tables, triggers, and restrictive RLS policies\n-- Affected tables: users, profiles, teams\n-- Special considerations: All RLS policies are restrictive - admin operations require service_role or application-level checks\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================================================\n\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  auth_user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  google_email text not null unique,\n  suggested_work_email text,\n  verified_work_email text,\n  verified_work_email_at timestamptz,\n  google_profile_picture text,\n  google_full_name text,\n  last_otp_sent_at timestamptz,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.users is 'Custom users table storing Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking.         "contents": "export async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile with optional select fields\n * Uses RLS policy to ensure user can only see their own profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @param selectFields - Optional select fields string (default: \"*\")\n * @returns The profile data if found, null otherwise\n */\nexport async function getCurrentUserProfile&lt;T = Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;&gt;(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient,\n  selectFields: string = \"*\",\n): Promise&lt;T | null&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  const { data: profile, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(selectFields)\n    .limit(1)\n    .single();\n\n  // Return null if query failed or no profile found\n  if (queryError || !profile) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  return profile as T;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "import { getCurrentUserProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\";\nimport { User, Users, Shield } from \"lucide-react\";\n\nconst ROLE_LABELS: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  student: \"Student\",\n  team_leader: \"Team Leader\",\n  coach: \"Kouč\",\n  admin: \"Admin\",\n};\n\nexport default async function DashboardPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const {\n    data: { user },\n  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // Get profile with team info\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n   \n  \n\n  return (\n    &lt;&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"mb-8\"&gt;\n        &lt;h2 className=\"text-3xl font-heading font-bold\"&gt;\n          Vítej, {profile?.name?.split(\" \")[0]}!\n        &lt;/h2&gt;\n        &lt;p className=\"text-muted-foreground mt-1\"&gt;\n          Toto je tvůj dashboard v Tappka.\n        &lt;/p&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* Stats cards */}\n      &lt;div className=\"grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3\"&gt;\n        {/* Profile card */}\n        &lt;Card&gt;\n          &lt;CardHeader className=\"flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;CardTitle className=\"text-sm font-medium\"&gt;Profil&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n            &lt;User className=\"h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground\" /&gt;\n          &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

        "contents": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\n   - User enters code to complete verification\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\n\n## Database Schema\n\n### Tables\n\n#### &#96;profiles&#96;\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: false |\n| school_email | TEXT | Yes | Verified school email |\n| locale | TEXT | No | Preferred language ('cs', 'en'). Default: 'cs' |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Registration time |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Last update time |\n\n#### &#96;teams&#96;\nTeam companies (tymove firmy)\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Team identifier |\n| name | TEXT | No | Team name |\n| year | INTEGER | No | Cohort year (1, 2, 3) |\n| is_active | BOOLEAN | No | Still active team? Default: true |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n#### &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96;\nAdmin-imported student list from Excel\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Record identifier |\n| email | TEXT (unique) | No | School email from Excel |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | No | Assigned team |\n| role | ENUM | No | Expected role |\n| full_name | TEXT | Yes | Name from Excel (optional) |\n| claimed_by | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | Yes | User who claimed this email |\n| claimed_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Yes | When claimed |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          {
            "text": "| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  // This is more reliable than nested selects with RLS\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1);\n\n  // Return false if query failed or no profiles found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if at least one profile exists\n  return Array.isArray(profiles) &amp;&amp; profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile with optional select fields\n * Uses RLS policy to ensure user can only see their own profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @param selectFields - Optional select fields string (default: \"*\")\n * @returns The profile data if found, null otherwise\n */",

        "contents": "// Reservation from database\nexport interface Reservation {\n  id: string;\n  room_id: string;\n  user_id: string | null;\n  team_id: string | null;\n  recurring_schedule_id: string | null;\n  reservation_type: ReservationType;\n  title: string;\n  reason: string | null;\n  person_count: number | null;\n  start_time: string;\n  end_time: string;\n  is_cowork_open: boolean;\n  status: ReservationStatus;\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n}\n\n// Reservation with joined data for display\nexport interface ReservationWithDetails extends Reservation {\n  room?: Room\n;\n}",

        "contents": "│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\n                          │ role (enum)     │\n                          │ removed_access  │\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\n                          │ created_at      │  │\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\n                                    ▲          │\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verification Logic\n\n- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",

        "contents": "| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;\nTemporary codes for school email verification\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Code identifier |\n| user_id | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | No | Who requested |\n| school_email | TEXT | No | Email to verify |\n| code | TEXT | No | 6-digit code |\n| expires_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Code expiration (10-15 min) |\n| attempts | INTEGER | No | Failed attempts count. Default: 0 |\n| used | BOOLEAN | No | Already used? Default: false |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n### Database Trigger\n\nOn new user signup (auth.users insert), automatically create a profile record:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, is_verified, created_at, updated_at)\n  VALUES (\n    NEW.id,\n    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role', 'student'),\n    FALSE,\n    NOW(),\n    NOW()\n  );\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## UI Screens\n\n### 1. Landing Page (&#96;/&#96;)\n\nMinimal design with Tappka branding:\n- Tappka logo/name\n- Subtitle: \"Studentsky portal Tiimiakatemia\"\n- Login form (email, password)\n- \"Prihlasit se\" button (TAP Red)\n- \"Nemas ucet? Zaregistrovat se\" link\n- Language toggle (CZ/EN)\n\n### 2. Registration Page (&#96;/auth/sign-up&#96;)\n\nForm fields:\n- Full name (required)\n- Email (required) - personal email for login\n- Password (required)\n- Role dropdown (required): Student, Team Leader, Coach, Admin\n- Team dropdown (required if Student/Team Leader): List of active teams\n- \"Zaregistrovat se\" button\n- \"Uz mas ucet? Prihlasit se\" link\n\n### 3. Verification Page (&#96;/verify&#96;)\n\n**Step 1: Enter school email**\n- Heading: \"Overeni skolniho emailu\"\n- Explanation text\n- School email input",

        "contents": "CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_email ON pre_registered_emails(email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_claimed_by ON pre_registered_emails(claimed_by);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_user_id ON verification_codes(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_school_email ON verification_codes(school_email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_expires_at ON verification_codes(expires_at);\n\n-- Function to handle new user signup\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, team_id, is_verified, locale, created_at, updated_at)\n    VALUES (\n        NEW.id,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n        COALESCE((NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role')::user_role, 'student'),\n        CASE \n            WHEN NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id' IS NOT NULL \n            THEN (NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id')::UUID \n            ELSE NULL \n        END,\n        FALSE,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'locale', 'cs'),\n        NOW(),\n        NOW()\n    );\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- Trigger to create profile on user signup\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n    AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n\n-- Function to update updated_at timestamp\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    NEW.updated_at = NOW();\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\n-- Trigger to auto-update updated_at on         "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "-- Tappka Reservation System Migration\n-- Creates tables for rooms, reservations, recurring schedules, cowork participants, room issues, and schedule breaks\n\n-- ============================================\n-- EXTENSIONS\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Required for EXCLUDE constraint (preventing overlapping reservations)\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;\n\n-- ============================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Reservation types\nCREATE TYPE reservation_type AS ENUM ('personal', 'training_session', 'houston_calling');\n\n-- Issue types for room problems\nCREATE TYPE issue_type AS ENUM ('locked', 'mess', 'technical', 'other');\nCREATE TYPE issue_status AS ENUM ('open', 'resolved');\n\n-- Schedule break types (Days of Joy, holidays, etc.)\nCREATE TYPE schedule_break_type AS ENUM ('days_of_joy', 'holiday', 'other');\n\n-- ============================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Rooms table\n-- Stores all reservable rooms with their rules\nCREATE TABLE rooms (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,          -- 'd126', 'd132', etc. (used in URLs)\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 'D126', 'Tichá místnost', etc.\n    description TEXT,                    -- Optional description\n    available_days INTEGER[],            -- NULL = all days, [3] = Wednesday only (0=Sun, 1=Mon, etc.)\n    can_have_ts BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,  -- Can have Training Sessions?\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Recurring schedules table\n-- Stores recurring Training Session schedules set by coaches\nCREATE TABLE recurring_schedules (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),",

        "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\n-- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere lower(trim(p.work_email)) = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification. Automatically linked when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Grant execute permissions for the trigger function\ngrant execute on function public.link_user_to_profile() to authenticated;",

                  "lineNumber": 3687,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Users can update their own user record\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can update their own user record\\\" on public.users\\nfor update\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id )\\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\\n\\n-- Users can insert their own user record (during signup via trigger)\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can insert their own user record\\\" on public.users\\nfor insert\\nto authenticated\\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- RLS POLICIES - PROFILES TABLE\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Users can view their own profile\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can view their own profile\\\" on public.profiles\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing (\\n  user_id in (\\n    select id\\n    from public.users\\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\\n  )\\n);\\n\\n-- ============================================ [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 3254,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- References the new users table instead of auth.users\\ncreate table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,\\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\\n  )\\n);\\n\\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership.                   "lineNumber": 3909,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Tappka Authentication System Migration\\n-- Creates tables for user profiles, teams, pre-registered emails, and verification codes\\n\\n-- Create role enum\\nCREATE TYPE user_role AS ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\n\\n-- Teams table (tymove firmy)\\nCREATE TABLE teams (\\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    year INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (year &amp;gt;= 1 AND year &amp;lt;= 3),\\n    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,\\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\\n);\\n\\n-- Profiles table (extends auth.users)\\nCREATE TABLE profiles (\\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    role user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',\\n    team_id UUID REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,\\n    school_email TEXT,\\n    locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cs' CHECK (locale IN ('cs', 'en')),\\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ N [... omitted end of long line]"
                },

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 4145,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\\n   - User enters code to complete verification\\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\\n\\n## Database Schema\\n\\n### Tables\\n\\n#### &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96;\\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\\n\\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: false |\\n| school_email | TEXT | Yes | Verified school email |\\n| locale | TEXT | No | Preferred language ('cs', [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- TRIGGERS\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\\n\\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\\nafter update of email on auth.users\\nfor each row\\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\\n\\n\\n-- ======================================= [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"CREATE TABLE reservations (\\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\\n    room_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\\n    user_id UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,  -- NULL for system reservations (HC)\\n    team_id UUID REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,      -- For TS reservations\\n    recurring_schedule_id UUID REFERENCES recurring_schedules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,  -- Link to recurring schedule\\n    reservation_type reservation_type NOT NULL DEFAULT 'personal',\\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\\n    reason TEXT,                         -- Required for personal reservations\\n    person_count INTEGER,                -- Required for personal reservations\\n    start_time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\\n    end_time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\\n    is_cowork_open BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,  -- Allow others to join?\\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled')),\\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Create trigger on auth.users table for email domain validation\\ndrop trigger if exists validate_czu_email_domain_trigger on auth.users;\\n\\ncreate trigger validate_czu_email_domain_trigger\\nbefore update of email, email_change on auth.users\\nfor each row\\nexecute function public.validate_czu_email_domain_trigger();\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- INDEXES\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\\ncreate index profiles_team_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id);\\ncreate index profiles_team_id_user_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id, user_id);\\ncreate index users_google_email_idx on public.users(google_email);\\ncreate index users_suggested_work_email_idx on public.users(suggested_work_email);\\ncreate index if not exists idx_realtime_messages_t [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 21551,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"create table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,\\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\\n  )\\n);\\n\\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership.                 },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 35926,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 6232,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Migration: Initial schema setup\\n-- Purpose: Creates complete database schema with tables, triggers, and restrictive RLS policies\\n-- Affected tables: users, profiles, teams\\n-- Special considerations: All RLS policies are restrictive - admin operations require service_role or application-level checks\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- ENUM TYPES\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- TABLES\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\\ncreate table public.users (\\n  id uuid prima [... omitted end of long line]"

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 6434,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &amp;#96;updated_at&amp;#96; column on every update.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\\ncreate table public.users (\\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\n  email text not null,\\n  name text,\\n  picture text,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\n);\\n\\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\n\\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\\ncreate table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\\n  work_email text unique no [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 6640,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- FUNCTIONS\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = public, auth\\nas $$\\ndeclare\\n  v_user_id uuid;\\n  v_auth_email text;\\nbegin\\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\\ [... omitted end of long line]"

Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\","

                  "lineNumber": 6874,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"create table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,\\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\\n  )\\n);\\n\\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\\n\\n-- ========================================================================= [... omitted end of long line]"

Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- TRIGGERS\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\\n\\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\\nafter update of email on auth.users\\nfor each row\\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\\n\\ncomment on trigger link_user_to_profile_trig [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Users can update their own user record\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can update their own user record\\\" on public.users\\nfor update\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id )\\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\\n\\n-- Users can insert their own user record (during signup via trigger)\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can insert their own user record\\\" on public.users\\nfor insert\\nto authenticated\\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- RLS POLICIES - PROFILES TABLE\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Users can view their own profile\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can view their own profile\\\" on public.profiles\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing (\\n  user_id in (\\n    select id\\n    from public.users\\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\\n  )\\n);\\n\\n-- ============================================ [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "            \"text\": \"-- RLS POLICIES - PROFILES TABLE\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8116,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8268,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8282,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8286,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8358,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\\n                          │ role (enum)     │\\n                          │ removed_access  │\\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\\n                          │ created_at      │  │\\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\\n                                    ▲          │\\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Verification Logic\\n\\n- **Unverified**: &amp;#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&amp;#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\\n- **Verified &amp;amp; Active**: &amp;#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **Access Revoked**: &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&amp;#96;\\n\\ [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8500,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"export type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8597,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .update({ \\n    user_id: user.id,\\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\\n  })\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\\n\\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &amp;#96;removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96; on every request to protected routes.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// Middleware check\\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\\n  .single();\\n\\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\\n// User has active access, continue...\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Estimated Complexity\\n\\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\\n\\n|------|------------|---------------|\\n\\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\\n\\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\\n\\n| Database [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 9242,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"   - No Row Level Security policies\\n   - No database triggers or functions\\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\\n\\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\\n\\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\\n\\n   - Queries &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96; table for linked user_id\\n   - Checks &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; is null for active access\\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\\n\\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\\n\\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Admin sets &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; timestamp and &amp;#96;removed_access_by&amp;#96; profile\\n   - Immediate effect on next request\\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\\n\\n## Authentication Flow Details\\n\\n### Step 1: Google Login\\n\\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handle [... omitted end of long line]"

Please use Google OAuth to sign in.';\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  v_provider := event-&amp;gt;'user'-&amp;gt;'raw_user_meta_data'-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'provider';\\n  v_app_metadata := event-&amp;gt;'user'-&amp;gt;'app_metadata';\\n  if v_provider is null and v_app_metadata is not null then\\n    v_provider := v_app_metadata-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'provider';\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  if event-&amp;gt;'user'-&amp;gt;'identities' is not null then\\n    for v_identity in \\n      select value from jsonb_array_elements(event-&amp;gt;'user'-&amp;gt;'identities')\\n    loop\\n      if v_identity-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'provider' = 'google' then\\n        v_has_google_identity := true;\\n        exit;\\n      end if;\\n    end loop;\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  if v_provider = 'google' or v_has_google_identity then\\n    return event;\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  raise exception 'Only Google OAuth signups are [... omitted end of long line]"
                },

                  "lineNumber": 10195,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"### &amp;#96;auth.jwt()&amp;#96;\\n\\nReturns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &amp;#96;raw_app_meta_data&amp;#96; column or the &amp;#96;raw_user_meta_data&amp;#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:\\n\\n- &amp;#96;raw_user_meta_data&amp;#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &amp;#96;supabase.auth.update()&amp;#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.\\n- &amp;#96;raw_app_meta_data&amp;#96; - cannot be updated by the user, so it's a good place to store authorization data.\\n\\nThe &amp;#96;auth.jwt()&amp;#96; function is extremely versatile. For example, if you store some team data inside &amp;#96;app_metadata&amp;#96;, you can use it to determine whether a particular user belongs to a team. For example, if this was an array of IDs:\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\ncreate policy \\\"User is in team\\\"\\non my_table\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( team_id in (select auth.jwt() -&amp;gt; 'app_metadat [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 23460,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"create table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,\\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\\n  )\\n);\\n\\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\\n\\n-- ========================================================================= [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 3903,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\\n */\\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(): Promise&amp;lt;boolean&amp;gt; {\\n  const supabase = await createClient();\\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\n\\n  if (error || !user) {\\n    return false;\\n  }\\n\\n  // Single query using nested select to check for linked profile\\n  // Joins users and profiles tables in a single database call\\n  const { data: userWithProfile } = await supabase\\n    .from(\\\"users\\\")\\n    .select(\\\"profiles(id)\\\")\\n    .eq(\\\"auth_user_id\\\", user.id)\\n    .single();\\n\\n  return !!userWithProfile?.profiles &amp;amp;&amp;amp; userWithProfile.profiles.length &amp;gt; 0;\\n}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- FUNCTIONS\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = public, auth\\nas $$\\ndeclare\\n  v_user_id uuid;\\n  v_auth_email text;\\nbegin\\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\\ [... omitted end of long line]"

Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\","

Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- TRIGGERS\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\\n\\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\\nafter update of email on auth.users\\nfor each row\\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\\n\\ncomment on trigger link_user_to_profile_trig [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"create table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,\\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\\n  )\\n);\\n\\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership.                   "lineNumber": 7007,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 9497,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"### &amp;#96;auth.jwt()&amp;#96;\\n\\nReturns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &amp;#96;raw_app_meta_data&amp;#96; column or the &amp;#96;raw_user_meta_data&amp;#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:\\n\\n- &amp;#96;raw_user_meta_data&amp;#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &amp;#96;supabase.auth.update()&amp;#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.\\n- &amp;#96;raw_app_meta_data&amp;#96; - cannot be updated by the user, so it's a good place to store authorization data.\\n\\nThe &amp;#96;auth.jwt()&amp;#96; function is extremely versatile. For example, if you store some team data inside &amp;#96;app_metadata&amp;#96;, you can use it to determine whether a particular user belongs to a team.                   "lineNumber": 18449,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"### &amp;#96;auth.jwt()&amp;#96;\\n\\nReturns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &amp;#96;raw_app_meta_data&amp;#96; column or the &amp;#96;raw_user_meta_data&amp;#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:\\n\\n- &amp;#96;raw_user_meta_data&amp;#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &amp;#96;supabase.auth.update()&amp;#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.\\n- &amp;#96;raw_app_meta_data&amp;#96; - cannot be updated by the user, so it's a good place to store authorization data.\\n\\nThe &amp;#96;auth.jwt()&amp;#96; function is extremely versatile. For example, if you store some team data inside &amp;#96;app_metadata&amp;#96;, you can use it to determine whether a particular user belongs to a team.                 },

                  "lineNumber": 18933,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- &amp;#96;anon&amp;#96;: an unauthenticated request (the user is not logged in)\\n- &amp;#96;authenticated&amp;#96;: an authenticated request (the user is logged in)\\n\\nThese are actually [Postgres Roles](mdc:docs/guides/database/postgres/roles).                   "lineNumber": 19627,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"   - No Row Level Security policies\\n   - No database triggers or functions\\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\\n\\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\\n\\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\\n\\n   - Queries &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96; table for linked user_id\\n   - Checks &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; is null for active access\\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\\n\\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\\n\\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Admin sets &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; timestamp and &amp;#96;removed_access_by&amp;#96; profile\\n   - Immediate effect on next request\\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\\n\\n## Authentication Flow Details\\n\\n### Step 1: Google Login\\n\\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handle [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 20457,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- FUNCTIONS\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = public, auth\\nas $$\\ndeclare\\n  v_user_id uuid;\\n  v_auth_email text;\\nbegin\\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\\ [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 20662,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\","

                  "lineNumber": 20687,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"create table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,\\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\\n  )\\n);\\n\\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\\n\\n-- ========================================================================= [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 20924,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .update({ \\n    user_id: user.id,\\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\\n  })\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\\n\\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &amp;#96;removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96; on every request to protected routes.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// Middleware check\\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\\n  .single();\\n\\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\\n// User has active access, continue...\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Estimated Complexity\\n\\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\\n\\n|------|------------|---------------|\\n\\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\\n\\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\\n\\n| Database [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 21365,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"'studenti.czu.cz',\\\\n  'pef.czu.cz',\\\\n] as const;\\\\n\\\\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\\\\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\\\\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\\\\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\\\\n\\\\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\\\\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&amp;amp;lt;ProfileRole, number&amp;amp;gt; = {\\\\n  student: 0,\\\\n  team_leader: 1,\\\\n  coach: 2,\\\\n  admin: 3,\\\\n} as const;\\\\n\\\\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &amp;amp;gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\\\\n};\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\\\\n\\\\nUpdate [&amp;amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;am [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 3393,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"### &amp;#96;auth.jwt()&amp;#96;\\n\\nReturns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &amp;#96;raw_app_meta_data&amp;#96; column or the &amp;#96;raw_user_meta_data&amp;#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:\\n\\n- &amp;#96;raw_user_meta_data&amp;#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &amp;#96;supabase.auth.update()&amp;#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.\\n- &amp;#96;raw_app_meta_data&amp;#96; - cannot be updated by the user, so it's a good place to store authorization data.\\n\\nThe &amp;#96;auth.jwt()&amp;#96; function is extremely versatile. For example, if you store some team data inside &amp;#96;app_metadata&amp;#96;, you can use it to determine whether a particular user belongs to a team. For example, if this was an array of IDs:\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\ncreate policy \\\"User is in team\\\"\\non my_table\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( team_id in (select auth.jwt() -&amp;gt; 'app_metadat [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- &amp;#96;anon&amp;#96;: an unauthenticated request (the user is not logged in)\\n- &amp;#96;authenticated&amp;#96;: an authenticated request (the user is logged in)\\n\\nThese are actually [Postgres Roles](mdc:docs/guides/database/postgres/roles). You can use these roles within your Policies using the &amp;#96;TO&amp;#96; clause:\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\ncreate policy \\\"Profiles are viewable by everyone\\\"\\non profiles\\nfor select\\nto authenticated, anon\\nusing ( true );\\n\\n-- OR\\n\\ncreate policy \\\"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\\\"\\non profiles\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( true );\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\nNote that &amp;#96;for ...&amp;#96; must be added after the table but before the roles. &amp;#96;to ...&amp;#96; must be added after &amp;#96;for ...&amp;#96;:\\n\\n### Incorrect\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\ncreate policy \\\"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\\\"\\non profiles\\nto authenticated\\nfor select\\nusing ( true );\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Correct\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "      \"parameters\": \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"link_users_to_profiles\\\",\\\"query\\\":\\\"-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\\\\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\\\\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\\\\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\\\\n\\\\n-- ============================================================================\\\\n-- FUNCTIONS\\\\n-- ============================================================================\\\\n\\\\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\\\\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\\\\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\\\\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\\\\nreturns trigger\\\\nlanguage plpgsql\\\\nsecurity definer\\\\nset search_path = public, auth\\\\nas $$\\\\ndeclare\\\\n  v_user_id uuid;\\\\n  v_auth_email text;\\\\nb [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"   - No Row Level Security policies\\n   - No database triggers or functions\\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\\n\\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\\n\\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\\n\\n   - Queries &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96; table for linked user_id\\n   - Checks &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; is null for active access\\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\\n\\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\\n\\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Admin sets &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; timestamp and &amp;#96;removed_access_by&amp;#96; profile\\n   - Immediate effect on next request\\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\\n\\n## Authentication Flow Details\\n\\n### Step 1: Google Login\\n\\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handle [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 10359,

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 12874,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"

Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\","

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\\\\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\\\\n  email: workEmail,\\\\n  token: otpCode,\\\\n  type: 'email'\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\\\\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\\\\n  .from('profiles')\\\\n  .select('id')\\\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\\\\n  .single();\\\\n\\\\nif (!profile) {\\\\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\\\\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// Link profile to current user\\\\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\\\nawait supabase\\\\n  .from('profiles')\\\\n  .update({ \\\\n    user_id: user.id,\\\\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\\\\n  })\\\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\\\\n\\\\nQuery database for profile li [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\\\\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\\\\n  email: workEmail,\\\\n  token: otpCode,\\\\n  type: 'email'\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\\\\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\\\\n  .from('profiles')\\\\n  .select('id')\\\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\\\\n  .single();\\\\n\\\\nif (!profile) {\\\\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\\\\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// Link profile to current user\\\\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\\\nawait supabase\\\\n  .from('profiles')\\\\n  .update({ \\\\n    user_id: user.id,\\\\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\\\\n  })\\\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\\\\n\\\\nQuery database for profile li [... omitted end of long line]"
                },

                  "lineNumber": 18379,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"      \\\"parameters\\\": \\\"{\\\\\\\"name\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"create_users_profiles_teams_schema\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"query\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"-- Create profile_role enum for profiles table\\\\\\\\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\\\\\\\\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\\\\\\\\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\\\\\\\\ncreate table public.users (\\\\\\\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\\\\\\\n  auth_user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\\\\\\\n  google_email text not null unique,\\\\\\\\n  suggested_work_email text,\\\\\\\\n  google_profile_picture text,\\\\\\\\n  google_full_name text,\\\\\\\\n  last_otp_sent_at timestamptz,\\\\\\\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\\\\\\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\ncomment on table public.users is 'Custom users table storing Google OAuth user da [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 18399,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"'studenti.czu.cz',\\\\n  'pef.czu.cz',\\\\n] as const;\\\\n\\\\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\\\\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\\\\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\\\\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\\\\n\\\\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\\\\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&amp;amp;lt;ProfileRole, number&amp;amp;gt; = {\\\\n  student: 0,\\\\n  team_leader: 1,\\\\n  coach: 2,\\\\n  admin: 3,\\\\n} as const;\\\\n\\\\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &amp;amp;gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\\\\n};\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\\\\n\\\\nUpdate [&amp;amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;am [... omitted end of long line]"

It's important to know the distinction between these two:\\n\\n- &amp;#96;raw_user_meta_data&amp;#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &amp;#96;supabase.auth.update()&amp;#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.\\n- &amp;#96;raw_app_meta_data&amp;#96; - cannot be updated by the user, so it's a good place to store authorization data.\\n\\nThe &amp;#96;auth.jwt()&amp;#96; function is extremely versatile.                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &amp;#96;updated_at&amp;#96; column on every update.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\\ncreate table public.users (\\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\n  email text not null,\\n  name text,\\n  picture text,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\n);\\n\\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\n\\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\\ncreate table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\\n  work_email text unique no [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 2864,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"

You can use these roles within your Policies using the &amp;#96;TO&amp;#96; clause:\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\ncreate policy \\\"Profiles are viewable by everyone\\\"\\non profiles\\nfor select\\nto authenticated, anon\\nusing ( true );\\n\\n-- OR\\n\\ncreate policy \\\"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\\\"\\non profiles\\nfor select\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( true );\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\nNote that &amp;#96;for ...&amp;#96; must be added after the table but before the roles. &amp;#96;to ...&amp;#96; must be added after &amp;#96;for ...&amp;#96;:\\n\\n### Incorrect\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\ncreate policy \\\"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\\\"\\non profiles\\nto authenticated\\nfor select\\nusing ( true );\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Correct\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql [... omitted end of long line]"
